Start: 1944-06-19  
Add 33 weeks = 33 × 7 = 231 days.  
Add 2 more days → total 233 days.  

1944 is a leap year (divisible by 4).  
Days from June 19 to end of June: 30 - 19 = 11 days.  
July: 31, August: 31, September: 30, October: 31, November: 30, December: 31.  

By Dec 31: 11 + 31+31+30+31+30+31 = 11 + 184 = 195 days elapsed.  
Remaining: 233 - 195 = 38 days into 1945.  

January 1945: 31 days → 38 - 31 = 7 days into February.  
February 7, 1945.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1945-02-07
